user.title: Connect SMS.to
user.description: Enter your SMS.to API key and the sender used for your messages. The key is checked by reading your balance — no SMS is sent.

data_description.sender_id: Phone number in international format (for example +40712345678) or a name of up to 11 characters. A phone number is also used to calculate the cost of an SMS.

cost_number.title: Number for the SMS cost
cost_number.description: The sender {sender_id} is a name, so it can't be used to calculate the cost of an SMS. Enter a phone number in the country you usually send to, in international format. Nothing is sent to it. Leave it empty to skip the cost and available SMS sensors.

data_description.cost_number: Used only to estimate the cost of an SMS; nothing is sent.

reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect SMS.to
reauth_confirm.description: SMS.to rejected the API key for sender {sender_id}. Enter a valid API key.

reconfigure.title: Update SMS.to settings
reconfigure.description: Change the API key, the sender, or the number used to calculate the SMS cost. The integration reloads with the new settings.

data_description.sender_id: Phone number in international format (for example +40712345678) or a name of up to 11 characters. A phone number is also used to calculate the cost of an SMS.
data_description.cost_number: Used only to estimate the cost of an SMS; nothing is sent.

error.invalid_auth: SMS.to rejected the API key. Check it in app.sms.to → Settings → API keys.
error.cannot_connect: SMS.to can't be reached. Check your internet connection and try again.
error.invalid_sender_id: Enter a phone number in international format or a name of up to 11 letters and digits.
error.invalid_number: The number isn't valid for SMS.to. Use the international format, for example +40712345678.
error.already_configured: Another SMS.to entry already uses this sender.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. Check the Home Assistant log.

notify_smsto.name: Send SMS via SMS.to
notify_smsto.description: Send an SMS notification through SMS.to

message.name: Message
message.description: The text of the notification to send. This is a required field.

title.name: Title
title.description: The title of the notification (optional). This will appear before the message text.

target.name: Target
target.description: A list of phone numbers to send the notification to. Each number should be in international format.

data.name: Additional Data
data.description: Platform-specific additional data (e.g., callback URL, priority). Include any extra parameters required by SMS.to.
